items.notes: Manual semantic review binds Cook4Me 'Beef meatballs' to USDA SR Legacy 'Meatballs, frozen, Italian style'. The target is explicitly a meatball product, its own pinned evidence contains this exact FDC record, and prior reviewed Cook4Me 'Frozen beef meatballs' independently used the same USDA record. Historical reuse is corroboration only, not identity proof. Confidence remains medium because the current target does not specify frozen state, seasoning, bread content, fat level, or Italian-style formulation; this review does not generalize to meatless meatballs, sauced meatballs, or mixed prepared meals.

items.fdcDescription: Beans, from dried, NS as to type, no added fat
items.notes: Manual semantic review binds Cook4Me 'Dried borlotti beans, soaked overnight' to USDA FNDDS 'Beans, from dried, NS as to type, no added fat'. The target explicitly identifies dried beans that are rehydrated without added fat, and its own pinned evidence contains this generic dried-bean record. The generic type-unspecified record is chosen deliberately instead of asserting that borlotti are white, black, pinto, kidney, or another USDA subtype. Confidence remains medium because soaking and subsequent cooking state can change water content and the catalog does not specify the weight basis after soaking; this review does not generalize to canned beans or beans cooked with added fat.
